description: This file defines the class HTML_Template_Flexy_Token_Tag, which models an HTML tag with attributes, prefix/postfix code, and methods for attribute management, used within the Flexy templating system.

classes.name: HTML_Template_Flexy_Token_Tag
classes.description: A class representing an HTML tag with attributes and associated code snippets, used in the Flexy templating engine.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Initializes the tag object with a tag name and attributes from an array.

methods.name: getAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves an attribute value by key, stripping quotes if present.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Returns all attributes as an array with quotes removed.

methods.name: clearAttribute
methods.description: Removes a specified attribute from the object.
